title: IFF develops Aquascent, a new water-based fragrance technology
summary: The fragrance specialist has announced the launch of Aquascent, a new vegan, water-based carrier for fine fragrance applications. Crafted from a proprietary formula based on biodegradable materials, Aquascent is designed, according to International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF), to deliver enhanced olfactive performance and visual clarity while supporting a more sustainable approach to fragrance formulation.
